IABP counterpulsation waveform landmark, not the generic systolic arterial pressure. Decisive evidence: the same schema family carries a PAIRED counterpart — MIMIC-IV 224309 'Assisted Systole' has abbreviation 'SYS - Assisted' with dict_category=IABP, alongside 224652 'Unassisted Systole' = 'SYS - Unassisted' (p50 94.3 vs 84.7 mmHg, same 586 stays, same timestamps); MIMIC-III CareVue likewise has itemid 2633 'unassisted systole'. Assisted vs unassisted is not a measurement method (both are invasive arterial-line transduced) but a different beat state, so rule 5 does not fold them together — assigning sbp would map two coexisting, numerically different fields of the same stay onto one concept. The patient's actual sbp in this database is already carried by 51 Arterial BP [Systolic] (p50 120.6) and 455 NBP [Systolic] (p50 119.0), and field 55 covers only the 695-stay IABP subpopulation (coverage 0.0364, identical to 59/62/224/225). The catalog has no IABP-landmark concept, so per rule 2 this is UNKNOWN rather than UNSURE — the evidence is sufficient to decide, it just decides against sbp. Consistent with the round-1 convention that a real field with a genuine cross-DB twin but no catalog concept goes to UNKNOWN (535 Peak Insp. Pressure, 444 Mean Airway Pressure).

BAEDP = balloon aortic end-diastolic pressure, the end-diastolic pressure AFTER balloon deflation, i.e. a device-lowered value, not the patient's diastolic pressure. MIMIC-IV's dictionary makes the pairing explicit: 224311 BAEDP = 'DIA - Assisted' (dict_category IABP, p50 47.1) versus 224654 PAEDP = 'DIA - Unassisted' (p50 52.8) — the unassisted member is the one that corresponds to the patient's own dbp, and both are charted for the same 586 stays. The magnitude of the deflation-induced drop is itself charted as a separate field (153 Diastolic Unloading, %, p50 6), confirming BAEDP is defined relative to the device cycle rather than being a plain dbp reading. Value-range overlap with dbp (p50 54.1 vs catalog dbp p50 57-59) is therefore coincidental and, per the log's §3.1/§7.3 boundary, may not be used to establish identity on its own. Same-database dbp is already carried by 8368 Arterial BP [Diastolic] and 8441 NBP [Diastolic]. No catalog concept exists for IABP waveform landmarks -> UNKNOWN.
